tabletH2: Room to breathe on a tablet.
tabletBody: An adaptive layout that makes the most of every display, from one hand on a phone to a spacious tablet.
tvH2: The Quran on the big screen.
tvBody: Muslim Haven now comes to Android TV. Fill your home with recitation, follow the verses from across the room and find any reciter or station with your remote.
tvPlaying: Now playing, with the verses beside the player
privacyH2: No ads. No tracking. No account.
privacyBody: Your location, favorites, playlists and recordings stay on your device, never on a server. The app only sends anonymous crash reports and usage statistics.
downloadBody: Free on Google Play, for phones, tablets and Android TV.
title: Muslim Haven: Quran & Prayer
metaDescription: Read and hear the Quran, live Quran radio, prayer times, adhan and the Qibla.
lede: Muslim Haven brings the Quran, its recitations and your daily prayers together in one calm, beautiful app.
name: Muslim Haven

rows.h2: Your day, from Fajr to Isha
rows.body: The next prayer, the verse you stopped at and what you were listening to, together on one calm home screen.

rows.h2: The whole mushaf, page by page
rows.body: Continue reading where you stopped, or start a khatma and keep track of it.
Live Quran radio stations from around the world. 244 reciters and nearly 300 recitations: Hafs, Warsh, Qalun and more.
Follow the verses as a recitation plays.
Accurate prayer times for any city, or from your location.

rows.h2: Find the Qibla in a moment

tiles.title: Adhan & reminders
tiles.body: Adhan and reminders before each prayer, with the voices you choose.

tiles.title: Home screen widgets
tiles.body: Home screen widgets for prayer times, the verse of the day, favorites and the player.

tiles.title: 12 languages
tiles.body: 12 languages, each with its own typeface, and full right-to-left support.

tiles.title: Playlists & favorites
tiles.body: Sleep timer, playback speed, playlists and favorites.

tiles.title: Hijri calendar
tiles.body: Hijri date, adjustable for your local moon sighting.

tiles.title: Frosted glass design
tiles.body: Frosted and glass design that adapts to your theme, or a calm, still look when you reduce motion.
